FRENCH — TERMLY EXAM #18
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Interactive speaking 1.2 Oral expression 1.3 Interactive listening 1.3 Active li, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Interactive speaking 1.2 Oral expression 1.3 Interactive listening 1.3 Active li.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Interactive speaking 1.2 Oral expression 1.3 Interactive listening 1.3 Active li.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Interactive speaking 1.2 Oral expression 1.3 Interactive listening 1.3 Active li.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Interactive speaking 1.2 Oral expression 1.3 Interactive listening 1.3 Active li.

2. When practising Listening for information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Listening for information.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for information.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Listening for information.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for information.

3. When practising Oral expression, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Oral expression.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Oral expression.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Oral expression.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Oral expression.

4. When practising Listening for information Vocabulary Grammar Attention, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Listening for information Vocabulary Grammar Attention.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Listening for information Vocabulary Grammar Attention.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for information Vocabulary Grammar Attention.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for information Vocabulary Grammar Attention.

5. When practising Interactive speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Interactive speaking.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Interactive speaking.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Interactive speaking.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Interactive speaking.

6. When practising Active Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Active Listening.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Active Listening.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Active Listening.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Active Listening.

7. When practising Interactive Speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Interactive Speaking.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Interactive Speaking.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Interactive Speaking.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Interactive Speaking.

8. The French word for “book” is: (1 mark)
   A. livre
   B. fenêtre
   C. chaise
   D. porte

9. “Bonjour” is used to say: (1 mark)
   A. Excuse me
   B. Good morning / hello
   C. Good night only
   D. Thank you

10. When practising Interactive listening 1.3 Active listening 1.4 Listening for information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Interactive listening 1.3 Active listening 1.4 Listening for information.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Interactive listening 1.3 Active listening 1.4 Listening for information.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Interactive listening 1.3 Active listening 1.4 Listening for information.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Interactive listening 1.3 Active listening 1.4 Listening for information.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
